description: This vector represents the concept of the global COVID-19 pandemic and its associated terminology.

This vector represents rules, limitations, and regulatory constraints.
This vector represents the concept of causing a change, action, or consequence upon something or someone.

This feature vector represents individual occurrences, instances, or medical cases.
This feature vector represents concepts of conditionality, derivation, and foundational causality.
